t.E964.agn: In the EU, the warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols (1169/2011 Annex III).
t.E964.body: When consumed in excess, it may cause gas and diarrhoea in the gut.
t.E964.eff.0.t: May cause gas, bloating and diarrhoea (laxative effect); in the EU, the warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols
t.E964.eff.1.t: Laxative effect has been reported (with hydrogenated glucose syrups; polyglycitol syrup consists of the same components in different proportions)
t.E964.eval: Polyol (sugar alcohol): in the EU, the warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols; avoided in sensitive gut (FODMAP) diets.
t.E964.prod: Obtained from sugar or starch by hydrogenation (a chemical process).
t.E964.regx.0: The warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols (1169/2011 Annex III).
t.E964.summary: A mixture of polyols (sugar alcohols) obtained by breaking down and hydrogenating starch. Used as a sweetener in sugar-free confectionery.
t.E964.what: A sugar alcohol (polyol): it provides sweetness and bulk in sugar-free products and retains moisture.
